title: Solutions Engineer
description: <p><strong>About Nscale</strong></p> <p>Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud supports strategic business outcomes including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.</p> <p>We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Principal Presales Engineer / Solutions Architect to join Nscale’s commercial organisation and play a key role in helping customers understand, evaluate, and adopt our AI infrastructure solutions.</p> <p>This is a deeply technical, customer-facing role at the intersection of sales, solution design, and AI infrastructure. You will partner closely with account executives, product, engineering, and operations teams to support the full sales cycle, from discovery and technical qualification through solution design, product demonstrations, proof of concept support, and customer onboarding.</p> <p>You will need to quickly become fluent in Nscale’s infrastructure, platform capabilities, and software orchestration stack so that you can confidently present our solutions, map customer requirements to technical architectures, and act as a trusted advisor throughout the buying journey.</p> <p>This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical credibility with commercial instinct, enjoys engaging directly with customers, and can translate complex GPU, AI, and cloud concepts into clear business value.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the commercial team in qualifying customer opportunities and identifying technical requirements early in the sales process</li> <li>Deliver compelling product demos, technical presentations, workshops, and architecture sessions for prospective customers and partners</li> <li>Translate customer AI, HPC, and infrastructure requirements into clear solution designs using Nscale’s platform</li> <li>Develop and present solution proposals that align technical architecture with customer business outcomes</li> <li>Work closely with customers to understand workloads, deployment requirements, performance expectations, and scaling plans</li> <li>Build a strong working knowledge of Nscale’s infrastructure stack, GPU cloud platform, APIs, orchestration tooling, and deployment models</li> <li>Support proof of concepts, evaluations, onboarding projects, and technical validation activities</li> <li>Partner with product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure proposed solutions are realistic, scalable, and aligned with platform standards</li> <li>Provide guidance on compute, networking, storage, orchestration, and workload optimisation for AI and machine learning use cases</li> <li>Help create repeatable demo environments, technical playbooks, reference architectures, and sales enablement materials</li> <li>Act as a technical voice in the commercial organisation, helping shape how Nscale positions its solutions in the market</li> <li>Surface customer feedback, product gaps, and recurring technical objections to internal stakeholders</li> <li>Support RFQ, BOM, and technical proposal development where required for larger or more complex opportunities</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll present technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>Experience supporting enterprise or mid-market sales cycles in infrastructure, cloud, AI, data centre, or platform environments</li> <li>Good understanding of cloud infrastructure, GPU compute, AI/ML workloads, or high-performance infrastructure</li> <li>Familiarity with containers, Kubernetes, Slurm, orchestration platforms, or workload deployment models</li> <li>Understanding of networking, storage, and distributed compute concepts in modern infrastructure environments</li> <li>Ability to quickly learn a complex technical platform and confidently represent it externally</li> <li>Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work cross-functionally across sales, engineering, product, and operations</li> <li>Commercial awareness and the ability to link technical solution design to customer outcomes and deal progression</li> <li>Strong written skills for creating solution overviews, proposals, diagrams, and customer-facing technical content</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Terraform or related orchestration and automation tools</li> <li>Experience delivering technical product demos in a presales or partner-facing environment</li> <li>Experience supporting AI start-ups, research organisations, model builders, or enterprise AI teams</li> <li>Understanding of high-performance networking concepts such as InfiniBand, RDMA, or RoCE</li> <li>Experience working with APIs, developer platforms, or cloud-native application environments</li> <li>Experience with open-weight model training and inference</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <ul> <li>You can confidently demo Nscale’s platform and explain its value to both technical and commercial stakeholders</li> <li>You become a trusted technical partner to the sales team and help accelerate qualified opportunities</li> <li>You can quickly assess customer requirements and map them to practical, compelling solution designs and architectures</li> <li>You help improve win rates by addressing technical objections with clarity and credibility</li> <li>You contribute to a repeatable presales motion through strong documentation, demos, and enablement content</li> <li>You build deep knowledge of Nscale’s infrastructure and software orchestration capabilities and use that knowledge to support customer adoption</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Join Nscale</strong></p> <p>At Nscale, you’ll help shape how customers adopt next-generation AI infrastructure. You’ll work with fast-growing AI companies and enterprise organisations, support strategic customer engagements, and play a visible role in translating Nscale’s technical capabilities into commercial success.</p> <p>You’ll be joining a company at the forefront of GPU cloud infrastructure, with the opportunity to influence customer outcomes, product feedback loops, and go-to-market execution. This role offers the chance to combine technical depth with real commercial impact.</p> <p><strong>Inclusion at Nscale</strong></p> <p>At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. title: Product Manager - QA & Release Coordination (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
description: As a Product Manager at Reonic , you’ll sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and our customers. You’ll help make sure new features are tested thoroughly, releases run smoothly, and customer feedback continuously makes its way back into the product development process. You’ll have a lot of ownership and work closely with engineers and other teams to improve both our product and the way we build and release it. Please note: This is a fully onsite role in Augsburg. What you'll do Own release testing: Coordinate testing for upcoming releases and continuously test new features during development. Identify issues early and provide clear, actionable feedback to engineering. Coordinate software releases: Keep track of features, changes, dependencies, and release timelines. Act as a communication hub between product, engineering, and other teams. Improve product quality: Look beyond whether a feature technically works. Think about edge cases, usability, customer workflows, and how changes affect the overall product experience. Turn feedback into action: Triage user feedback and bug reports, investigate issues, reproduce problems, and translate findings into clear, well-described tickets for engineering. Communicate what's new: Create release notes, run internal demos, and make sure colleagues understand what has changed and how new functionality works. Work closely with engineering: Collaborate with engineers throughout the development process, ask the right questions, and help remove ambiguity before features reach customers. Understand our customers: Build a deep understanding of the businesses using Reonic and use that context to make better product decisions. What Makes You a Great Fit Product mindset: You naturally think beyond checklists. You want to understand why something is being built, who it is for, and what makes it useful. Attention to detail: You spot inconsistencies, edge cases, and potential issues before they become customer problems. Strong communication: You can clearly communicate with engineers, product colleagues, and other stakeholders. Professional fluency in English (C1+) is required. Technical curiosity: You enjoy understanding how software works and aren't afraid to dig into technical details, investigate bugs, or learn new concepts. Customer orientation: You care about the experience of the people using the product and can turn qualitative feedback into actionable insights. Ownership: You take responsibility, follow things through, and don't wait for someone else to solve a problem that you can help solve yourself. Startup mindset: You’re comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and processes are still being built. Relevant experience: Experience in product management, product operations, QA, software development, B2B SaaS, or a similar role is a plus. A degree in economics, engineering, computer science, or a related field is also helpful, but not required. Why Join Us? Real impact: Help build software that enables businesses to accelerate the transition to renewable energy. A product people use: Our platform is already used by 3,000+ paying B2B customers , giving you the opportunity to work on a product with real users and real-world impact. High ownership: We’re a growing company, and nothing is set in stone. You’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work and how the product evolves. Fast-moving environment: Work closely with engineering and other teams, make decisions quickly, and see your work reach customers. A great international team: We work hard, learn from each other, and make sure we have fun along the way. Great setup: MacBook, gym membership subsidy, regular team events, coffee, Deutschland ticket and other perks. Competitive compensation: We offer competitive pay based on your experience and responsibilities. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn't hold you back— we value talent and passion above all. About Reonic At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology. Our AI operating system helps renewable energy installers run and grow their businesses — from planning and selling solar, battery storage, and heat pump solutions to managing their day-to-day operations. Today, more than 3,000 businesses use Reonic, and we’re growing fast. Location This is a full-time, on-site position based in Augsburg. Ready to shape the future of renewable energy? Apply now! title: Frontend Web Application Developer
description: Location: Remote Availability: 35-40 hours per week Working hours: US East business hours Reporting to: Lead developer KoboToolbox has an immediate opening for a Frontend Web Application Developer to fill a full-time position of approximately 35-40 hours per week, for a commitment of at least 1 year. As a member of our team, you will share in the challenge and excitement of writing code used by over 32,000 organizations around the world. These organizations create data-driven change through the collection and analysis of more than 20 million surveys per month. Only candidates who already have experience working on large web applications will be considered. Beyond technical acumen, we are seeking a team member who demonstrates curiosity, initiative, and a cooperative approach to problem solving and decision-making. If you're passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact, we want to hear from you! Responsibilities Searching and reading an extensive, long-lived code base to understand existing behavior and conventions. Recognizing when existing conventions may no longer be the best approach and suggesting improvements aligned with contemporary best practices. Writing robust, concise, and reusable code with accompanying tests and documentation. Reviewing other developers' code and providing constructive feedback. Incorporating feedback from code reviews to improve your skills and align with team standards. Using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining responsibility for code quality and correctness. Efficiently investigating bug reports from the support team, creating well-scoped fixes or actionable plans for resolution. Scoping, prioritizing, estimating, and organizing work into manageably sized tasks. Attending regular video-conference check-ins with other members of the technical team. Communicating with the public in conjunction with our support staff or directly through forums, issue trackers, etc. Contributing to discussions about design and architecture collaboratively with the larger team. Performing other related duties as directed by the lead developer. Requirements Required Qualifications Professional experience writing, deploying, and maintaining client-side code for real-world, API-driven single-page applications. Proficiency with TypeScript, React, and related technologies, including styling, state management, and efficient data exchange over HTTP. Unflinching ability to work with legacy technologies such as Backbone and CoffeeScript. Recent experience giving and receiving code reviews. Ability to independently set up and troubleshoot a local development environment, knowing when to ask for help on genuine roadblocks. Interest in data collection (surveying), particularly in humanitarian emergencies and other challenging contexts, and a desire to improve our platform for our users. Proficiency with spoken and written English. Fluency with Git. Overlap with working hours in the Eastern time zone. Average availability of at least 30 hours per week, preferably 35 hours or more. Preferred Qualifications Experience with the following is preferred but not required to apply: Using Docker and Docker Compose in a development environment. Programming in Python, ideally with Django (and particularly Django REST Framework). Building user-facing LLM integrations. Surveying with XLSForm, ODK XForm, and OpenRosa. Integrating with Stripe for payment processing. An added note on qualifications... We know that people from underrepresented groups including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and others are less likely to apply for a role if they don't meet every qualification listed. We're more interested in your potential and growth mindset than a perfect checklist match. If this role excites you and you meet many, but not all, of the qualifications, we'd still love to hear from you. Equal Opportunity Employer Kobo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Benefits Genuine Impact: Contribute directly to projects that impact millions of people around the world globally, working alongside the largest international humanitarian organizations as well as thousands of national and small community based partners in 200 countries. Meaningful Work Environment: Join a team that believes work should be meaningful as well as fun, tackling global challenges through innovative data collection and management tools with a proven impact for lasting change. Diverse Team: Be part of an amazing, progressive, and globally diverse team that values diversity, equity, and inclusion across all spectrums. Flexible Work Culture: Enjoy mutual flexibility supported by a culture that prioritizes work-life balance. Professional Development: Benefit from generous professional development options. Full Time Employee Benefits (U.S. candidates only) : Health & Wellness : 5 medical insurance options, dental, and vision (up to 80% premium covered), plus life insurance and Long Term Disability. Financial Security : 401(k) retirement plan with 100% match up to 2%. Work-Life Balance : 20 days paid time off, 12 floating holidays, unlimited sick days, and paid parental leave. *Please note, if based in the US or Canada this is a full time employee position. title: Embedded Electrical Engineer - SoM
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the role As an Embedded Electrical Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to design the compute modules and associated boards used across our platforms. You will own these designs end-to-end, from system architecture and schematic through layout guidance, fabrication, bring-up, and qualification. This is a high-impact role that combines demanding high-speed design work with hands-on bench work, taking hardware from a first prototype through to boards that fly. Responsibilities Board Design: Design SoMs, baseboards, and test boards for our compute platforms. High-Speed Digital Design: Design around high-end application processors, covering PCIe, 10 Gb Ethernet, USB 3.x, and MIPI, managing layout constraints and signal integrity. Power Design: Design power trees, sequencing, and conversion topologies, and verify power-up and power-down behaviour. Design Reviews: Prepare and lead design reviews at each milestone, from block diagram to release for fabrication. Manufacture: Work with PCB and EMS partners on stack-up, via technology, layout guidance, and cost trade-offs. Bring Up and Qualification: Define verification test plans, troubleshoot and characterise boards, and run thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the embedded software team through board bring-up, the mechanical team on form factor and thermal constraints, and validation for flight qualification. Candidate requirements Educational Background: MSc in electrical, computer, or a related engineering field. A PhD is a plus. A hands-on design and bring-up record matters more than the specific degree. Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded hardware design, with boards taken from specification through bring-up and qualification into production. Technical Expertise: High-speed design including layout constraints, signal integrity, and validation. Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. Power trees with deliberate conversion topologies and verified power-up and power-down behaviour. Tools: In-depth knowledge of electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium). Testing Proficiency: Proficiency with electronic test equipment and experience planning thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification. Manufacturing: Experience working with fabrication and assembly partners on stack-up, via technology, and cost trade-offs. Problem Solving: Rigorous, structured, and analytical; able to work autonomously and see a board from concept through to production. Communication and Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to present design and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Additional Skills: FPGA or MPSoC design, prior work deploying AI inference on embedded targets, and UAS, drone, or defence hardware experience are strong advantages. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. title: Junior Computational Geometry Engineer
description: SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed. The Role As a Junior Computational Geometry Engineer, you work on the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack: the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model, reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right. You start on well-scoped parts of that engine, next to the engineers who built it, and grow into owning them. Your code runs in the factory. What We're Looking For Foundations . Degree in computer science, mathematics, mechanical engineering or a related field, with real depth in geometry, linear algebra and numerics. Internships, thesis work or serious side projects count. We do not expect years of production experience. B-rep Basics . You are comfortable with topology, NURBS, meshes and point clouds. You may never have shipped a robust boolean, and you still understand why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations, and you want to learn how the field handles it. Kernel Exposure . You have worked with a geometry kernel and mesh libraries in at least one project: OpenCASCADE, CGAL, libigl, Open3D, PCL, Parasolid or comparable. Technical Ability . Solid modern C++ (17+) plus Python for tooling and rapid iteration. Rust is welcome. You write code others can read, test and maintain. Manufacturing Curiosity . You want to understand what happens once geometry meets a spindle, a nozzle or a fixture. CNC, additive or metrology exposure is a bonus, never a requirement. First Principles Thinker . You reason by physics and mathematics, not analogy. When an algorithm fails on a real part, you dig until you know whether the bug sits in the code, the model or the assumption. Learning Speed . You take direct feedback, apply it immediately, and close your own knowledge gaps without waiting to be taught. Industrial Grit . You want to stand next to the machine in Germany and watch your output run. The feedback loop between your code and cutting metal is the point. On - site . Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland. What we're not looking for Researchers who want to publish and hand off. You ship. CAD users. This is a role for people who build the tools, not drive them. Engineers who need a clean spec. The problem is defined by the part, the machine, and the customer - you'll help define it. People who treat “it works on the test model” as done. Real customer CAD is broken, degenerate, and adversarial. That is the job. Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities. What we offer Mission : Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your work directly enables production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space. Total Ownership : High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions - and have the authority to execute. The Environment : Access to a 8,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial 3D printers. Your algorithms run on real hardware from day one. The Team : "Special Forces" model. Everyone senior, everyone ships. No politics, no bureaucracy. Direct feedback, high standards. Compensation : Competitive salary + meaningful equity. Location : Zurich HQ, with occasional time at Factory ONE in Munich. Apply Resume : Focus on the geometry work you have actually done. Thesis, internships, projects, coursework. GitHub / Portfolio : Show us the hardest problem you have solved. Code, a write-up, or a part that came off a machine because of you. Cover letter : Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first? Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the role As an Embedded Electrical Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to design the compute modules and associated boards used across our platforms. You will own these designs end-to-end, from system architecture and schematic through layout guidance, fabrication, bring-up, and qualification. This is a high-impact role that combines demanding high-speed design work with hands-on bench work, taking hardware from a first prototype through to boards that fly. Responsibilities Board Design: Design SoMs, baseboards, and test boards for our compute platforms. High-Speed Digital Design: Design around high-end application processors, covering PCIe, 10 Gb Ethernet, USB 3.x, and MIPI, managing layout constraints and signal integrity. Power Design: Design power trees, sequencing, and conversion topologies, and verify power-up and power-down behaviour. Design Reviews: Prepare and lead design reviews at each milestone, from block diagram to release for fabrication. Manufacture: Work with PCB and EMS partners on stack-up, via technology, layout guidance, and cost trade-offs. Bring Up and Qualification: Define verification test plans, troubleshoot and characterise boards, and run thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the embedded software team through board bring-up, the mechanical team on form factor and thermal constraints, and validation for flight qualification. Candidate requirements Educational Background: MSc in electrical, computer, or a related engineering field. A PhD is a plus. A hands-on design and bring-up record matters more than the specific degree. Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded hardware design, with boards taken from specification through bring-up and qualification into production. Technical Expertise: High-speed design including layout constraints, signal integrity, and validation. Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. Power trees with deliberate conversion topologies and verified power-up and power-down behaviour. Tools: In-depth knowledge of electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium). Testing Proficiency: Proficiency with electronic test equipment and experience planning thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification. Manufacturing: Experience working with fabrication and assembly partners on stack-up, via technology, and cost trade-offs. Problem Solving: Rigorous, structured, and analytical; able to work autonomously and see a board from concept through to production. Communication and Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to present design and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Additional Skills: FPGA or MPSoC design, prior work deploying AI inference on embedded targets, and UAS, drone, or defence hardware experience are strong advantages. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. Le contexte   Suite à une croissance rapide et rentable en France, Doctrine s'est développée en Italie et en Allemagne, puis a racheté Maïté, une legaltech espagnole, au début de l'année 2026. Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un·e Engineering Manager pour continuer à améliorer notre IA juridique sur le marché espagnol.  C’est un rôle stratégique qui impactera la roadmap produit et les futurs succès de Doctrine en Espagne.   À noter : le poste est basé à Paris, dans nos bureaux du 18e arrondissement.   Tu trouveras le détail de notre stack technique sur Github !   Bon à savoir : une expérience professionnelle préalable dans le domaine juridique n'est pas requise. En revanche, l'envie de t'investir et de monter en compétence sur la compréhension de documents juridiques est essentielle. Les missions 🛠 Manager une équipe pluridisciplinaire (software engineers, data engineers, machines learning engineers).
